spec.description: Every aircraft adsb.lol's volunteer receivers hear, moving on the map, and the last week of their positions as this instance recorded them, replayed over the time range. Click the charts to filter by kind of flight, airline, type, altitude or country. Coverage is dense over Europe and North America and thin elsewhere. The history needs the recorder (compose profile `recorder`). Data: adsb.lol, ODbL.

-- The live snapshot through the gateway, which asks adsb.lol once a minute.
WITH live AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN coalesce(db_flags, 0) & 1 = 1 THEN 'Military'
      WHEN category LIKE 'C%' OR category LIKE 'B%' THEN 'Ground & other'
      WHEN category = 'A7' THEN 'Helicopter'
      WHEN regexp_matches(coalesce(flight, ''), '^(FDX|UPS|GTI|CLX|ABW|BOX|CKS|CAO|DHK|BCS|DHX|ABX|ATN|GEC|CKK|NCA|PAC|MPH|AJT|QAC|ICV|SWN|TAY|CJT|KYE|LCO|MSX)[0-9]') THEN 'Cargo'

  AND (${airline:sqlstring} = '' OR airline = ${airline:sqlstring})

  AND (${altband:sqlstring} = '' OR altband = ${altband:sqlstring})
  AND (${country:sqlstring} = '' OR country = ${country:sqlstring})
